preconditions.description: The total number of cells on the board does not exceed 2 * 10^5.
Both the height and width of the board are positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: Each row in the board has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'U', 'D', 'L', 'R'} for row in board for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the board is one of 'U', 'D', 'L', or 'R'.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct photos Bill can take, where each photo is uniquely identified by the pair of free cells.
